'''Ince''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Along with several other [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], including Sergeant [[Coric]]<ref name="No Prisoners" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Ince accompanied [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] to [[JanFathal]] as part of a mission aimed at rescuing the captured [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Hallena Devis]]. He received a severe wound to his thigh, just above the knee, and while he was kept alive and transported back to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Leveler]]'', he [[Death/Legends|succumbed]] to his injuries shortly thereafter. He only had eight days of service out of Kamino.<ref name="No Prisoners" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Gentlemen, show me some life signs before I resort to CPR&hellip;''"<br />"''Receiving, sir, just&hellip;awaiting orders.''"<br />"''You can move, you know. And talk.''"<br />"''Yes, sir.''"<br />"''Permission to engage in witty banter&mdash;in your own time, go on.''"<br />"''Witty banter commencing, sir&hellip;stand by.|Captain Rex and Ince|<ref name="No Prisoners" />}}
Ince was considered the "funny man" of his squad. He often had a witty remark at the ready, whatever the situation.<ref name="No Prisoners" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ince first appeared in the [[2009]] book ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="No Prisoners" />
